newsitem.title: GERMANY: Otto Versand win German logistics award.
newsitem.headline: Otto Versand win German logistics award.

text.p: German mail order company Otto Versand has won the 1996 German Logistics Award, the Germany shipper association (BVL) said.
Otto Versand gained the BVL award for its successful 700 million marks five year re-design of its warehousing system which increased warehouse productivity by 27 percent, the BVL said.

The company cut the time from when an order is processed to to delivery to 2.3 days from five days by more flexible delivery working times, introducing Germany-wide 24-hours delivery services and opening two additional distribution centres.
